[Item 1: Travel Expenses - Hangzhou to Beijing Project Seminar]

Step 6: Check — Compare lodging rate (RMB 600/night) against the bureau-director-level accommodation standard for Beijing. Result: PASS.
Step 7: Compute — Calculate meal allowance: RMB 100/day × 3 calendar days. Result: 300.
Step 8: Check — Verify claimed meal subsidy (RMB 300) against calculated allowance. Result: PASS.
Step 9: Compute — Calculate maximum lump-sum local transportation allowance: RMB 80/day × 3 days. Result: 240.
Step 10: Check — Verify actual local transportation reimbursement (RMB 180 with receipts) does not exceed maximum. Result: PASS.
Step 11: Check — Verify no external unit shared transportation, lodging, meal, or local transportation expenses. Result: PASS.
Step 12: Check — Verify no self-driving or vehicle rental was involved. Result: PASS.
Step 13: Conclusion — All travel expense requirements have been satisfied. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: National Teaching Forum Conference Expenses]
Step 1: Check — Whether conference expense type is correctly identified. Result: PASS.

Step 3: Check — Whether required supporting materials are submitted (notice, agenda, budget, detailed expense list, sign-in sheet, invoices, contracts). Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Whether lodging standard complies with Rule 9.1.1 (500 per person per day). Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Whether meal standard complies with Rule 9.1.1 (150 per person per day). Result: PASS.
Step 6: Check — Whether other expenses standard complies with Rule 9.1.1 (100 per person per day). Result: FAIL.
Step 7: Compute — Total per person per day: 500 + 150 + 110 = 760. Result: 760.
Step 8: Check — Whether total per person per day complies with Rule 9.1.1 (750 per person per day). Result: FAIL.
Step 9: Check — Whether no advance payment was made (Rule 9.5). Result: PASS.
Step 10: Check — Whether reimbursed in single batch (Rule 9.3). Result: PASS.
Step 11: Conclusion — Other expenses at 110 exceeds standard of 100 by 10; total at 760 exceeds standard of 750 by 10. Only amounts within the quota standards are reimbursable. Excess amount of 10 per person per day for 100 persons over 2 days (10 × 100 × 2 = 2,000) should be excluded. Result: Partially Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Printing/Office Supplies for Conference Handbook]
Step 1: Check — Whether expense type is correctly identified as office expenses or printing expenses. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Whether seller-provided goods list exists. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Whether invoice amounts were artificially split across invoices issued during the same period. Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Check — Whether artificial splitting was done to avoid the threshold for required review list. Result: FAIL.
Step 5: Conclusion — Per Rule 6.5: 'Invoice amounts shall not be artificially split in order to avoid the review requirement.' This is a clear violation. Per Rule 4.8, incomplete reimbursement procedures disqualify the expense. The expense cannot be reimbursed. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Training Program Expenses (University Financial Digitalization Training Program)]
Step 1: Check — Verify training duration and applicable quota standard. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Compute — Calculate expected quota for bureau-director-level: 650 × 15 days. Result: 9,750 RMB total; breakdown: accommodation 6,000, meals 2,250, venue/materials/transportation 1,050, other 450.
Step 3: Check — Compare actual lodging expense (7,500) against quota (6,000). Result: Exceeds by 1,500 RMB.
Step 4: Check — Compare actual venue/materials expense (1,200) against quota (1,050). Result: Exceeds by 150 RMB.
Step 5: Check — Verify written approval for increased standard. Result: PASS - separate written approval attached.
Step 6: Check — Verify instructor's expenses against standards. Result: PASS - lodging 500 ≤ 400/day, meals 150 ≤ 150/day, intercity transport follows travel rules.
Step 7: Check — Verify lecture fees against Rule 13 standards. Result: Unclear - instructor title not specified, so cannot verify if 500/1,000/1,500 per class hour limit is met.
Step 8: Check — Verify required supporting materials per Rule 10(3). Result: FAIL - 'Fudan University Detailed List of Training Expense Expenditures' is missing.
Step 9: Conclusion — Determine final audit result. Result: Not Reimbursable - missing required supporting document per Rule 10(3).

[Item 2: Professor Li's Business Trip to Beijing]

Step 2: Check — Verify transportation class for bureau-director-level personnel. Result: PASS - first-class train seat is permitted (first-class seat on high-speed rail/EMU allowed).
Step 3: Compute — Check lodging against Beijing bureau-director standard (Appendix 1: 650/day). Result: 600/night × 2 nights = 1,200 RMB; 1,200 ≤ 650 × 2 = 1,300; PASS.
Step 4: Compute — Calculate meal allowance: 100/day × 3 days. Result: 300 RMB claimed; 300 ≤ 100 × 3 = 300; PASS (exact match).
Step 5: Compute — Calculate lump-sum local transportation allowance: 80/day × 3 days. Result: 240 RMB claimed; matches standard 80 × 3 = 240; PASS.
Step 6: Check — Verify no external bearing of expenses. Result: PASS - confirmed no external unit bore transportation or lodging.
Step 7: Check — Verify no self-driving or car rental. Result: PASS - confirmed.
Step 8: Conclusion — Determine final audit result. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Doctoral Dissertation Defense Remuneration]
Step 1: Check — Verify number of reviewers: 5 reviewers reported, Rule 13.1 allows 5 to 8 reviewers at RMB 300-500 per person. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Verify number of defense committee members: 5 members reported, Rule 13.1 allows 5 to 7 members at RMB 300-500 per person. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Verify defense secretary: 1 secretary reported at RMB 150, matches Rule 13.1 exactly. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Verify per-person rates: reviewers at RMB 300 (within RMB 300-500 range), defense committee at RMB 300 (within range), secretary at RMB 150 (matches standard). Result: PASS.
Step 5: Conclusion — All doctoral dissertation defense remuneration amounts fall within the standard ranges specified in Rule 13.1. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Special Lecture Fee for Bureau-Director-Level Lecturer]
Step 1: Check — Verify personnel level: The case states a 'bureau-director-level person or person of equivalent rank' was invited to deliver the lecture. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Verify class hours: 4 class hours reported for a half-day lecture, which matches the maximum allowed under Rule 13.2 (maximum of 4 class hours for each half day). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Compute — Calculate standard-compliant maximum lecture fee: Bureau-director-level rate ceiling of RMB 500 per class hour × 4 class hours = RMB 2,000 maximum reimbursable. Result: 2000.
Step 4: Compute — Calculate claimed lecture fee: RMB 900 per class hour × 4 class hours = RMB 3,600 claimed. Result: 3600.
Step 5: Check — Compare claimed fee against standard: RMB 3,600 claimed exceeds RMB 2,000 maximum by RMB 1,600 (45% over the rate ceiling). Result: FAIL.
Step 6: Conclusion — The lecture fee rate of RMB 900 per class hour exceeds the Rule 13.2 maximum of RMB 500 per class hour for bureau-director-level personnel. The entire lecture fee is not reimbursable. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 3: International Conference Expenses]

Step 2: Check — Verify reimbursement is in single batch: Expenses were reimbursed in one batch through the same channel, complying with Rule 9.3. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Verify accommodation expense against Category III standard: RMB 300 per person per day reported, Category III standard is RMB 340 per person per day. The rate is below the standard but exceeds the adjusted quota calculation when other components are considered. Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Check — Verify meal expense against Category III standard: RMB 200 per person per day reported, Category III standard is RMB 130 per person per day. The rate exceeds the standard. Result: FAIL.
Step 5: Check — Verify other expenses against Category III standard: RMB 250 per person per day reported, Category III standard is RMB 80 per person per day. The rate significantly exceeds the standard. Result: FAIL.
Step 6: Check — Verify total against comprehensive quota: RMB 750 per person per day exceeds Category III total of RMB 550 per person per day. Result: FAIL.
Step 7: Check — Verify Category I venue rental standard: RMB 200 per person per day matches Category I standard exactly (RMB 200 per person per day). Result: PASS.
Step 8: Check — Verify equipment rental standard: RMB 100 per person per day matches the stated standard exactly (RMB 100 per person per day). Result: PASS.
Step 9: Check — Verify cold buffet reception standard: RMB 220 per person per occasion matches Category I standard (RMB 220 per person per occasion). Result: PASS.
Step 10: Check — Verify staff ratio: 10 staff total with 5 resident staff = 50% resident ratio, which equals the maximum allowed (shall not exceed 50%). Result: PASS.
Step 11: Check — Verify staff board and lodging: RMB 450 per person per day matches standard. Result: PASS.
Step 12: Check — Verify volunteer meal-delay subsidy: RMB 100 per person per day matches standard. Result: PASS.
Step 13: Check — Verify simultaneous interpretation: RMB 6,000 per interpreter per day for non-UN official language matches standard. Result: PASS.
Step 14: Check — Verify written translation: RMB 200 per 1,000 words matches standard. Result: PASS.
Step 15: Check — Verify vehicle rental: RMB 1,500 per vehicle per day for 30-seat bus (large bus >25 seats) matches standard. Result: PASS.
Step 16: Conclusion — The accommodation, meals, and other expenses per person per day (RMB 750 total) exceed the Category III comprehensive quota standards (RMB 550 total) under Appendix 2. While venue, equipment, reception, staff, translation, and vehicle expenses comply with standards, the basic lodging, meals, and other expense components fail to meet the quota requirements. Result: Partially Reimbursable.
